adapter_G.candidate_set: Exactly the candidate action strings already scored by the frozen base-policy scorer at that scoring point; G may not add, delete, filter, relabel, or inspect branch-equivalence classes.
adapter_G.formula: delta(a,z)=dot(unit_l2(z),unit_l2(q(a))); adjusted_whole_action_logscore(a)=base_whole_action_logscore(a)+delta(a,z). Identity coefficient 1.0 is frozen; there is no tunable gain/temperature.
adapter_G.normalization: If a normalized probability distribution is required for endpoint scoring, normalize adjusted whole-action logscores over the same frozen candidate set only.
adapter_G.runtime_use: G outputs adjusted scores only. Environment/action execution is outside G and forbidden in this PRE_SCIENCE freeze.

arm_realization.ALIGNED_RECURSION: Starting from sealed z0, execute exact F sequentially over sealed transition features in authenticated causal order; expose current recurrent state to exact G at inherited matched locations.
arm_realization.MATCHED_INFORMATION: Use same sealed z0, state width/dtype, F/G call identities/count/sites/timing and information-volume budget. Sequentially update using fixed P(x_t) control features in authenticated causal order.
arm_realization.NO_CARRY: No z/F/G state interface; inherited null semantics.
arm_realization.STATIC_ONESHOT: Expose sealed z0 exactly once at inherited oneshot G location; no F update.
arm_realization.STATIC_REPEAT: Expose byte-identical sealed z0 at every matched G location. At every matched updater slot execute the same F callable in an isolated scratch chain on the same sealed x_t inputs, but the scratch state has no directed path to G or endpoint scoring; exposed state remains z0.
arm_realization.TRANSITION_PERMUTED: Use same sealed z0, same sealed transition-feature multiset, same F/G, same call count/sites/budgets. Apply the accepted deterministic nonidentity permutation only when every permuted source record has already causally occurred; no future preview. Only transition replay order differs from ALIGNED_RECURSION.

canonical_serialization.action_payload: RFC8259-style UTF-8 JSON object with exactly key action; separators comma/colon with no extra whitespace; ensure_ascii=false; value is exact candidate action string already scored by the frozen base-policy scorer.
canonical_serialization.tokenization: Frozen model tokenizer revision; add_special_tokens=false; no chat template; no decode/re-tokenize normalization after tokenization.
canonical_serialization.transition_payload: RFC8259-style UTF-8 JSON object with exactly keys command,observation; keys sorted lexicographically; separators comma/colon with no extra whitespace; ensure_ascii=false; values are exact runtime-causally-observed strings; no branch/family/evaluator fields.

enabling_method: Parameter-free native-hidden-state recurrence and nonexecuting cosine whole-action reranking are the prospective enabling method used to instantiate CPDS with no architecture fitting. This method is not itself the mechanism claim and is not evidence that native hidden geometry is privileged.

feature_basis.action_feature: For each exact candidate action string already present in the frozen base-policy scoring set, run one isolated standalone frozen-model forward on canonical action JSON; take final model-normalized hidden immediately before lm_head at final input token; convert BF16->FLOAT32; apply exact unit_l2. G never receives graph branch-equivalence membership or evaluator target labels.
feature_basis.feature_sealing: z0 and every transition feature are content-hashed and sealed before any arm-specific transformation or endpoint scoring. All matched arms consume byte-identical sealed z0 and transition feature bytes except the explicitly frozen MATCHED_INFORMATION scramble and TRANSITION_PERMUTED order.
feature_basis.transition_feature: For each authenticated already-observed (command_t, observation_t+1), run one isolated standalone frozen-model forward on canonical transition JSON; no generation, no mutable KV/cache carry from any family/arm/slot; take final model-normalized hidden immediately before lm_head at final input token; convert BF16->FLOAT32; apply exact unit_l2.
feature_basis.unit_l2: u(v)=v/sqrt(sum_i v_i^2), computed FLOAT32 with deterministic reduction order i=0..2047; require every input/output finite and norm_squared>0; no epsilon, learned normalization, PCA, projection, whitening, SVD, or outcome-selected basis.
feature_basis.z0_source: Exact normal base-policy pre-reset forward: final model-normalized hidden vector immediately before lm_head at the last model-visible token before reset. No evaluator-secret, outcome-only, branch-id, family-id, source-graph-id, or future-transition field may contribute.

frozen_model_basis.minimality_rationale: d_z=2048 is exactly the frozen model native hidden width. Any d_z<2048 would introduce a new projection/bottleneck whose basis and dimension have no pre-outcome authority; any d_z>2048 adds capacity without necessity. This is not a claim that 2048 is the scientifically minimal sufficient latent dimension.

method_mechanism_distinction.mechanism_role: The mechanism claim concerns whether temporally aligned causal updates contain predictive information that is lost when the same static state is repeated or the same observed transition multiset is replayed in a prospectively permuted order.
method_mechanism_distinction.scope_guard: Such a null/refutation is scoped to CPDS_NATIVE2048_UNIT_SUM_RECURRENCE_V1 plus its frozen native feature/G realization unless later independent evidence justifies broader generalization.

matched_information_control.application: Keep byte-identical z0. At each matched-information update slot call the exact same F callable on P(x_t) instead of x_t; expose the resulting recurrent state to the exact same G. Operation label remains CONTROL_MATCHED_UPDATE_SLOTS because only control-scrambled inputs are allowed to reach the exposed state.
properties: independent of family id, branch labels, evaluator secrets, outcomes, and future transitions
matched_information_control.scope: This is a task-irrelevant native-basis scramble control. It is not claimed to erase all mutual information; it tests whether generic same-budget recurrence/basis perturbation explains the active effect.

mechanistic_hypothesis: If temporally ordered authenticated transition dynamics carry causal predictive state beyond static content, generic same-budget recurrence, and transition content without correct order, then ALIGNED_RECURSION should produce a larger first-action-excluded future-branch log-probability shift than BOTH STATIC_REPEAT and TRANSITION_PERMUTED under the exact matched randomized-slot design; MATCHED_INFORMATION tests whether generic same-budget recurrent computation/native-basis perturbation is sufficient.

recurrent_state.F_callable: F(z,x)=unit_l2(z+x), elementwise FLOAT32 addition then exact unit_l2
recurrent_state.boundedness: Every valid exposed recurrent state has L2 norm exactly one up to deterministic FLOAT32 arithmetic; nonfinite or zero-norm update is TECHNICAL_INVALID_ENTIRE_SPLIT.
recurrent_state.order_specificity: F is applied sequentially. The aligned final state is fold(F,z0,[x_1,...,x_n]); the permuted final state is fold(F,z0,[x_pi(1),...,x_pi(n)]). A byte-identical aligned/permuted final state is PREOUTCOME_CONSTRUCTIBILITY_INCONCLUSIVE for the whole split, never a dropped/replaced family.

runtime_timing_and_isolation.causal_rule: A transition feature cannot be constructed or consumed before its exact authenticated source record is RUNTIME_CAUSALLY_OBSERVED.
runtime_timing_and_isolation.immutable_input_packet: Per family, sealed z0 plus sealed transition features are read-only carrier inputs cloned into isolated arm slots. Mutable F/G state, caches, RNG, outputs, or scratch buffers never flow across arms, randomized slots, or families.
runtime_timing_and_isolation.matched_budget_rule: ALIGNED_RECURSION, STATIC_REPEAT, TRANSITION_PERMUTED, MATCHED_INFORMATION use state capacity 2048xFLOAT32, same feature width/dtype, same F callable identity/zero params, same G callable identity/zero params, same candidate set, same G exposure count/locations, same update slot count/timing, and same runtime geometry.
runtime_timing_and_isolation.oneshot_and_nocarry: Remain intentionally non-exposure-matched baselines exactly as accepted constructibility authority.
runtime_timing_and_isolation.permuted_rule: The permuted replay over a set of records may begin only at the inherited contracted replay/scoring phase where all records in that permutation have already causally occurred. No future transition is previewed.
runtime_timing_and_isolation.static_scratch_rule: STATIC_REPEAT scratch recurrence is computation matching only; validator must prove no scratch-to-G/endpoint path.

scope_and_terminals.constructibility_failure: Any realization-specific preoutcome guard failure is CONSTRUCTIBILITY_INCONCLUSIVE or TECHNICAL_INVALID as prospectively classified; it is never mechanism refutation.
scope_and_terminals.no_science_authorization: This freeze and its eventual review do not themselves authorize model/environment science. Fresh executable implementation/readiness, source/manifests/assignment freezes, and required independent reviews remain mandatory.
scope_and_terminals.not_planunique_retest: This is not a retest of one-shot residual sufficiency: no plan-minus-neutral residual is injected, no frozen layer/alpha residual operating point is selected, z is recomputed by an ordered multi-transition recurrence, and the decisive active-vs-permuted contrast holds z0, transition multiset, F, G, capacity, and exposure geometry fixed while changing only temporal order.
scope_and_terminals.null_scope: A future valid null/refutation applies to CPDS_NATIVE2048_UNIT_SUM_RECURRENCE_V1 plus its exact feature/G realization; it is not a universal refutation of all possible dynamic predictive-state architectures.
scope_and_terminals.support_scope: A future independently valid PASS may support ordered CPDS recurrence under this exact parameter-free native-2048 realization and frozen graph/model/task scope only.
